relationships.evidence_quote: The serum level of CGRP was positively correlated with the scores of abdominal pain

key_findings: Children with functional dyspepsia had higher serum CGRP and nesfatin-1 than controls, with no difference in ghrelin.
Serum CGRP correlated positively with abdominal pain, belching and total FD scores.
